mace.measurement_scope: Seven analytic harmonic-bond training configurations; these fit errors are not a held-out generalization measurement. Initialization includes first MACE/e3nn imports and both models; Torch was imported beforehand.

limitations: Committee disagreement is not a calibrated prediction error; physical_converged and converged remain false.
Generic callbacks must be deterministic under pinned numerical/software versions. The sampler must return all evolving state; its supplied NumPy RNG is checkpointed.
Uncommitted callbacks are replayed from the previous stage. There is no automatic mid-epoch optimizer or remote-reference-job checkpoint.
References must be independent and stateless; hidden electronic warm starts are rejected. i-PI requires a pinned driver identity/hash and explicit independent_frames declaration.
The MACE reference hook supports fixed-composition, nonperiodic molecules on CPU float64; it fine-tunes compatible preceding weights with a fresh Adam optimizer.
Every label batch retains a complete cumulative dataset snapshot, giving approximately quadratic retained data storage at fixed batch size.
Model reconstruction and hashing at stage boundaries can dominate very short sampling segments.
The analytic pilot is a one-dimensional fixed-box classical Metropolis validation, not molecular RPMD rate or physical convergence validation.

integration_notes.readme_en: Restartable active-learning loops connect batched reference labelling, callback training and resampling, with hashed datasets/model versions and an optional CPU MACE training/fine-tuning hook; committee disagreement remains an uncalibrated diagnostic.
